sections.content: Modern CSS pipelines: PostCSS/LightningCSS for transpiling and minification, Stylelint for linting, Browserslist for target queries, and CSS modules or Tailwind for architecture.
LightningCSS is the fast Rust-based compiler gaining adoption; nesting and custom media queries still need it for older browsers. Always measure bundle impact — unused CSS ships to users.
Key points: purge unused selectors in production, autoprefixer is fading as browsers catch up, and source maps keep debugging sane.
